lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are organized into distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill region. In the mid-flank area, columns contain between 4 to 6 local maxima with approximately uniform vertical and horizontal spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the visible lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance transition. A primary ridge runs longitudinally with high-intensity pixels on its dorsal edge and a well-defined shadow gradient on its ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Two elongated, high-contrast features with longitudinal stripes are visible in the ventral water column, oriented parallel to the primary subject's body axis.
